trait_description.value: Ginjana isn't flat-footed to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of 11th level or lower, or by creatures of 11th level or lower using surprise attack.
When Ginjana rolls a success on a Reflex save, she gets a critical success instead.
Ginjana takes 20 damage for every hour she's exposed to sunlight.
Ginjana critically succeeds at an attack roll, the target of the attack is clumsy 1 and flat-footed until the end of Ginjana's next turn.
When Ginjana Strides or Steps, she ignores 3.
Ginjana's movement doesn't trigger reactions when she Strides to move half her Speed or less.

(poison); DC 29 Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1: 3d6 negative damage and 2d6 poison damage (1 round); Stage 2: 3d6 negative damage, 2d6 poison damage, and enfeebled 1 (1 round); Stage 2: 3d6 negative damage; 2d6 poison damage; and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

(precision)

Ginjana deals an extra 2d6 precision damage to flat-footed creatures.
On the first round of combat, if Ginjana rolls Deception or Stealth for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are flat-footed to her.

action_description.value:
(magical, range increment 120 feet, reload 2) 2d10+13 piercing plus shadow essence
Effects: shadow essence

Trigger: An attack roll to Strike Ginjana fails or critically fails

Ginjana redirects the attack to a creature of her choice that is adjacent to her and within reach of the triggering attack. The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

description.value:
You shoot a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target is a fiend or undead, you deal an extra 5d6 good damage.

Critical Success: The target takes double fire damage, as well as double good damage if a fiend or undead.
Success: The target takes full damage If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, searing light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target

higher_level_description.value: Heightened (+1): The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the good damage against fiends and undead increases by 2d6.
